_meta.concept: Magazine grips re-authored after the playtest ("the thumb does not wrap around the magazine"): the magazine is held between a thumb curled on its near (camera-side) face and fingers wrapped round the front edge onto the far face. Supersedes the placement and thumb of remove.json/insert.json.
_meta.fit: Hand placement (6 DOF), fingers and thumb states fitted together with a (1+1)-ES and coordinate polish on numpy linear-blend skinning of the decimated glove with 4 influences (the glTF skinning), BVH signed distance with ray-parity inside tests, digit triangle crossings, and the game camera: thumb IP 40-55 and MCP 20-35 about the calibrated hinge, distal thumb within ~2 mm of the magazine, proximal within ~2.5 mm, tip ahead of the rear edge on the near face, visible IP/MCP bends in the projected game view, fingertips wrapped round the front edge (tips past the magazine centre plane), no digit crossings, no rifle contact.
_meta.removal: hold = thumb curled on the near face after the click; press = the thumb reaches back past the rear edge only to put its tip on the paddle (0.26-0.30 s); prepress = 3-4 mm short of it; via/hover = the path off the paddle round the rear corner onto the near face (searched frame by frame); squeeze = the grip tightening for the yank.
_meta.insert: insert_hold = thumb curled on the near face, tip toward the magazine well; insert_squeeze = the thumb press at the hook and the seat tap; insert_letgo = thumb lifted off before the hand slides away.
_meta.sources: Fitted outside the repository (scratch optimiser runs R15 = removal, I15 = insert, via search for the press-to-hold path); the numbers below are the result, viewmodel_v2.py only reads them.
_meta.limits: All states pass hand_pose.validate (thumb cmc_flex clamped to the -20 limit).
_meta.knownLimit: Distal thumb contact share: a pad resting on a flat face can put at most ~11% of the distal phalanx vertices within 2 mm of it (about 20% only when pressed 1 mm in); these holds reach ~15% (removal) and ~12% (insert).
